articles.title: China seeks to build ties with Iran
articles.description: HONG KONG, Nov 9 (Reuters) - China is willing to pursue stronger ties with Iran, China's special envoy to the Middle East Zhai Jun said in talks with Ali Bagheri Kani, deputy secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council.Zhai met Kani in Iran, according to a readout from China's foreign ministry on Monday. He is visiting Iran, Oman and Saudi Arabia this month, as China steps up efforts to ease tensions in the Middle East.

articles.title: Strait Of Hormuz Oil Route Gets US Clearance, Iraq Seeks Export Relief After $60 Billion War Losses
articles.description: Iraq secures US understanding for oil exports through Hormuz near Oman after USD 60 billion in war losses, while Washington demands tighter Iranian border restrictions.

articles.title: Iraq reaches US understanding to resume oil exports through Strait of Hormuz, says foreign minister
articles.description: Iraq has reached an understanding with the US to allow its oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz using a shipping lane near Oman, Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein said. Iraq's losses from the Iran war and disruptions to oil shipments have reached $60 billion. Exports recovered to 3.5 million bpd in October.

articles.title: Task Force Iron Gate in "full force" in Iran, says Donald Trump
articles.description: The announcement outlined two parallel US measures targeting Iranian trade and supply routes. While Task Force Iron Gate will focus on Iran's land borders and the Caspian Sea, the existing naval blockade, announced in July, covers Iranian ports along the Arabian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman.
